concept.title: MAGNIFICO LATTE
concept.description: Clean top-down motion graphics of the word MAGNIFICO being formed as classic barista latte art inside a white ceramic coffee cup using white microfoam on dark espresso.

identity.name: White ceramic coffee cup
identity.material: Matte white ceramic, dark espresso, white microfoam
identity.details: Perfect circular rim, glossy dark coffee surface, realistic milk foam texture

strict_consistency: Foam only forms the word MAGNIFICO

camera_direction.camera_journey: Perfectly fixed top-down angle for the entire duration. Only the liquid surface animates.

visual_style.materials_and_texture: Realistic crema, tiny foam bubbles, soft specular light, clean surface

required_properties: Formed entirely by white milk foam

beats.description: Top-down view of still dark espresso surface inside the white cup. A thin stream of white microfoam begins pouring.
The microfoam is precisely poured and shaped, forming the letters of MAGNIFICO from left to right in clean latte-art style.
The full word MAGNIFICO is completed and centered. Foam settles with realistic tiny bubbles while staying fully legible.
Final subtle settling of the foam under soft light. Hold on the finished word.

negative_prompt: No side view of the cup
